notes: The Salt Atlas is a self-contained, seeded canvas artwork with three evolving movements, pointer-driven field disturbances, parameter controls, optional synthesized audio responsive to scene and pointer activity, fullscreen mode and 3200×2000 PNG export rendered from the live generative field. Seed is stored in the URL hash. Animation uses a lightweight 2D field with adaptive render resolution. Chromium browser checks via Playwright verified scene navigation, control-panel and density interaction, pause/resume, PNG download and no page errors; a 390px viewport had no horizontal overflow. Direct file:// navigation was blocked by the environment policy, so cold-open from disk was not verified. Sustained 60 FPS was not benchmarked.
